title: Improvements of 177 Lu SPECT images from sparsely acquired projections by reconstruction with deep-learning-generated synthetic projections.
summary: Deep-learning-generated synthetic projections reconstructed sparse 177Lu SPECT acquisitions; 16 sequential patients were used to assess image quality and dosimetric agreement against full projections. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
